method: Archive record and full colour viewer inspected through CUA
description: De pastorie aan de Oppert (nummers 107-109) van de oud-katholieke kerk H.H. Laurentius en Maria Magdalena aan de Lange Torenstraat.
rights: Hermans, E.A.R.; Downloadbaar: Nee. Only viewed as research reference; no image copied to runtime or repository.
observedPalette: Dark brown masonry, pale off-white window frames and cornice/pediment, dark blue-green doors, near-black railing, muted brown-grey tile roof.
observedForm: Broad residential facade, two doors, central pediment with date1791, continuous pitched roof behind cornice, two dormers and two chimney stacks visible. Not the narrow church front.
limitations: A watercolour is an artist interpretation, not a measured paint sample. Its catalogued1940 date does not prove it was drawn before14May or from life. Does not independently prove destruction of the parsonage. Number range107-109 contradicts tentative mapreading103/105; resolve before integration.
acquisitionSupport: Rotterdams Jaarboekje1941 pLVI names the acquisition of E.A.R.Hermans watercolours including the Oud-Katholieke parsonage at Oppert. PDF read directly.
